title: Vikrant ki diary mein kya raaz tha?
hook_why: Opens with proper noun 'Vikrant' at frame 0, immediate revelation hook, promises specific dated clue — matches top-performing mystery hooks with named entity + date stamp.
metaphor: A dusty box under the bed acts as a time capsule — each artifact (receipt, ID, diary) peels back a layer of the identical stranger's life, culminating in a warning that the past is literally stepping into the present.

cast.Sharma ji: 58 years old, weathered face with deep laugh lines, thick graying mustache, receding salt-and-pepper hair tied in a small knot at the back, khaki watchman uniform with brass buttons and a faded society badge, always carries a wooden lathi with a red cloth wrapped around its handle
cast.Inspector Vikram Rathore: tall Indian man in his 40s, grey stubble, long dark brown coat, old steel wristwatch, always holding a small brass torch. Reuse this description verbatim in every prompt that shows him.
